args: command -v roadmap-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec roadmap-mcp; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uvx --from 'roadmap-core[files]>=0.3.1,<0.4' roadmap-mcp; echo 'roadmap: roadmap-mcp not found and uvx unavailable; pip install "roadmap-core[files]>=0.3.1,<0.4"' >&2; exit 127

for py in python3 python; do command -v "$py" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$py" -c "import repoctx.mcp_server" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$py" -m repoctx.mcp_server; done; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uv run --no-project --with 'repoctx-mcp>=1.6' python -m repoctx.mcp_server; python3 -m pip install --quiet --break-system-packages 'repoctx-mcp>=1.6' 1>&2 && exec python3 -m repoctx.mcp_server; echo "repoctx: could not launch the MCP server (no Python with repoctx-mcp, no uv, and pip install failed). Fix with: pip install 'repoctx-mcp>=1.6'" >&2; exit 1
